triage.desk_query: Term sheet G07 states: "Autocall Observation Dates and Autocall Levels (as a percentage of the Initial Level): 20 January 2027 at 100%, 20 January 2028 at 95%, 20 July 2028 at 90%." The booking record field autocall_level_pct is ['100', '100', '100'], i.e. a flat 100% trigger on all three observation dates, which omits the stepping schedule. Please confirm the autocall levels step down to 95% and 90% on the second and third observation dates and have the booking amended accordingly, or advise if a flat 100% trigger was intentionally agreed and documented elsewhere.
triage.cited_clause: Autocall Observation Dates and Autocall Levels (as a percentage of the Initial Level): 20 January 2027 at 100%, 20 January 2028 at 95%, 20 July 2028 at 90%.
triage.rationale: Both extractors agree on an unambiguous, explicit stepping schedule in the term sheet, so the flat 100% booking appears to be a data-entry error rather than a document defect.
